description: One fixture and one case table for every message-search interface: the Rust MessageService on each SearchSurface, the aise binary's CLI and MCP server, and the Python binding and entry point. Shared cases pass an explicit limit or all_results and compare result identity and order as [seq, role]; presentation (field views, match views, byte budgets) is deliberately not compared, per REQ004. deliberate_differences pins the documented surface-specific defaults of REQ003. twins adds that many tied pairs (same seq, user then assistant); expected "twins" means every pair in seq order, user first. tool_twins does the same for tool rows (an assistant tool call then its tool result, sharing one tool name), searched by field "tool_name"; a case without field searches content. reads name a seq whose rows every message-read interface must return in full and in the same order; newest_reads take the newest rows of the session, printed oldest-first.
